d:
I'm going to be honest, the first part of this story was perfect in my opinion. The only bad thing I can say about that first part is that they could have added more pregnancy scenes with the mom. But oh well.

Then the second part came out, and I was not a fan. I don't like that it's mainly about the aunt. I wanted it to stay a mother-and-son incest story, and they did not even give a mother a proper vaginal pregnancy sex scene. The one thing I was missing from the first part. And then I thought, Ok, this story has to be over now.

But then they release this third part. And it does not add a lot, in my opinion. Now the story feels not complete without a fourth part.

I'm already too deep into this story, so here you guys go, but honestly again, they could have stopped at the second part in my opinion.

Also, this has been out for a while, and nobody has even bothered uploading it here.
